module: Submodule of the editor's Tree Spline tool: plants or removes trees (Forest instances) along a spline. Relies on editor/toolUtilities/foliageScatter (scatterLine, removeItems, ensureForest) and editor/toolUtilities/occupancy (exclusion mask). The planted instances are stored in spline.items and spline.count.
notes: populateTreeSpline plants nothing (and empties the list) if spline.divPoints has fewer than 2 points.
The occupancy mask is only used if spline.avoidInfrastructure is true; without a built mask, it has no effect.

tryRemove.desc: Removes from the Forest the instances previously planted for this spline, then empties spline.items and sets spline.count back to 0. No effect if spline or spline.items is nil.

populateTreeSpline.desc: (Re)plants the spline: deletes its old instances then distributes a new regular row along the centerline (divPoints, binormals) according to the foliage parameters (species, speciesWeights, spacingM, posVariance, scaleVariance, alignToNormal, slopeMaxDeg, seed). Fills spline.items and spline.count.

spline.desc: Tree spline with its foliage parameters.

release.desc: Used during a Lua reload: the tool lets go of the trees of a locked spline without deleting them (they belong to the level) and returns their keys and positions for adopt().

returns.desc: List of {key, x, y, z} for each kept tree.

adopt.desc: Takes back the trees returned by release() that still exist in the Forest (found by key and position) and updates spline.items / spline.count.

spline.desc: Spline that gets its trees back.
